<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

Existing RDA object identifiers are retained for compatibility. Mplus folders,
run-file prefixes, reports, tables and figures use the current analysis numbering.

# Purpose and model sequence

This report presents the sequential EMA multilevel CFA reported in the manuscript. It compares the following three nested models:

1. **Model 1 (1W1B):** one general factor within persons and one general factor
   between persons;
2. **Model 2 (1W2B):** one general factor within persons and correlated
   Peripheral and Core factors between persons;
3. **Model 3 (2W2B):** correlated Peripheral and Core factors at both levels.

In every model, the between-person residual variance of `P2` is fixed to zero.
The six indicators are treated as continuous and estimated with MLR in Mplus 8.7. The two sequential comparisons
are calculated in R in the order Model 2 versus Model 1 and Model 3 versus
Model 2. They follow the official
[Mplus scaled-MLR guidance](https://www.statmodel.com/chidiff.shtml); ordinary
subtraction of the reported robust chi-square statistics is not used.

S2.5 remains the reproducible audit of how the common `P2@0` constraint changes
the three solutions. S2.6 presents the final constrained models and results.

```{r setup}
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(candidate)) candidate <- dirname(candidate)
  repeat {

  }
```

# Define the three final P2@0 models

`FW`, `PW`, and `CW` denote within-person general, Peripheral, and Core
factors. `FB`, `PB`, and `CB` denote their between-person counterparts.

```{r model-specifications}
model_specs <- list(
  M1_1W1B = list(
    order = 1L,
    label = "Model 1: 1W1B with P2@0",
    stem = "s2_6_m1_1w1b_p2_between_residual0",
    title = "S2.6 Model 1 with between-level P2 residual fixed to zero;",
    within_structure = "General PSMU",
    between_structure = "General PSMU",
    model = paste(
      "%WITHIN%",
      "fw BY p1-p6;",
      "%BETWEEN%",
      "fb BY p1-p6;",
      "p2@0;",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ),
  M2_1W2B = list(
    order = 2L,
    label = "Model 2: 1W2B with P2@0",
    stem = "s2_6_m2_1w2b_p2_between_residual0",
    title = "S2.6 Model 2 with between-level P2 residual fixed to zero;",
    within_structure = "General PSMU",
    between_structure = "Peripheral + Core",
    model = paste(
      "%WITHIN%",
      "fw BY p1-p6;",
      "%BETWEEN%",
      "pb BY p1-p2;",
      "cb BY p3-p6;",
      "pb WITH cb;",
      "p2@0;",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ),
  M3_2W2B = list(
    order = 3L,
    label = "Model 3: 2W2B with P2@0",
    stem = "s2_6_m3_2w2b_p2_between_residual0",
    title = "S2.6 Model 3 with between-level P2 residual fixed to zero;",
    within_structure = "Peripheral + Core",
    between_structure = "Peripheral + Core",
    model = paste(
      "%WITHIN%",
      "pw BY p1-p2;",
      "cw BY p3-p6;",
      "pw WITH cw;",
      "%BETWEEN%",
      "pb BY p1-p2;",
      "cb BY p3-p6;",
      "pb WITH cb;",
      "p2@0;",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  )
)

model_plan <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(model_specs), function(model_id) {
  specification <- model_specs[[model_id]]
  data.frame(

}))

  }, logical(1)))
)

knitr::kable(model_plan)
```

# Fit the final models in Mplus 8.7

```{r fit-mplus-models}
flatten_messages <- function(x) {
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_character_)
  values <- trimws(as.character(unlist(x, recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE)))
  values <- values[nzchar(values)]
  if (!length(values)) NA_character_ else paste(unique(values), collapse = " | ")
}

run_mplus_model <- function(model_id, specification) {
  model_stem <- specification$stem
  data_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(model_stem, ".dat"))
  input_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(model_stem, ".inp"))
  output_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(model_stem, ".out"))

  mplus_object <- MplusAutomation::mplusObject(
    TITLE = paste(
      "! Author: Kunru Song",
      "! Missing values are declared as . and handled by default MLR FIML.",
      specification$title,
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    VARIABLE = "CLUSTER = cluster;",
    ANALYSIS = paste(
      "TYPE = TWOLEVEL;",
      "ESTIMATOR = MLR;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    MODEL = specification$model,
    OUTPUT = paste(
      "SAMPSTAT;",
      "STANDARDIZED(STDYX);",
      "CINTERVAL;",
      "RESIDUAL;",
      "TECH1;",
      "TECH4;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    usevariables = c("cluster", mplus_item_names),
    rdata = mplus_data,
    autov = FALSE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  MplusAutomation::mplusModeler(
    object = mplus_object,
    dataout = data_path,
    modelout = input_path,
    run = 1L,
    check = FALSE,
    varwarnings = TRUE,
    Mplus_command = mplus_command,
    writeData = "always",
    hashfilename = FALSE,
    killOnFail = TRUE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  stopifnot(file.exists(data_path), file.exists(input_path), file.exists(output_path))
  input_lines <- readLines(input_path, warn = FALSE)
  output_lines <- readLines(output_path, warn = FALSE)
  p2_zero_count <- sum(grepl(
    "^\\s*p2\\s*@\\s*0\\s*;\\s*$",
    input_lines,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    perl = TRUE
  ))
  other_indicator_zero_count <- sum(grepl(
    "^\\s*p(1|3|4|5|6)\\s*@\\s*0\\s*;\\s*$",
    input_lines,
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    perl = TRUE
  ))
  input_checks <- list(
    author_present = any(trimws(input_lines) == "! Author: Kunru Song"),
    missing_declared = any(grepl(
      "MISSING\\s*=\\s*\\.;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    mlr_declared = any(grepl(
      "ESTIMATOR\\s*=\\s*MLR;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    twolevel_declared = any(grepl(
      "TYPE\\s*=\\s*TWOLEVEL;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    cluster_declared = any(grepl(
      "CLUSTER\\s*=\\s*cluster;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    categorical_absent = !any(grepl(
      "CATEGORICAL", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, fixed = TRUE
    )),
    exactly_one_p2_zero_constraint = p2_zero_count == 1L,
    no_other_indicator_zero_constraint = other_indicator_zero_count == 0L
  )
  stopifnot(all(unlist(input_checks, use.names = FALSE)))

  parsed <- MplusAutomation::readModels(
    target = output_path,
    what = "all",
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  list(
    model_id = model_id,
    model_label = specification$label,
    model_order = specification$order,
    specification = specification,
    model_syntax = specification$model,
    paths = list(data = data_path, input = input_path, output = output_path),
    input_checks = input_checks,
    normal_termination = any(grepl(
      "THE MODEL ESTIMATION TERMINATED NORMALLY",
      output_lines,
      fixed = TRUE
    )),
    parsed = parsed
  )
}

model_runs <- lapply(names(model_specs), function(model_id) {
  run_mplus_model(model_id, model_specs[[model_id]])
})
names(model_runs) <- names(model_specs)

if (!all(vapply(model_runs, `[[`, logical(1), "normal_termination"))) {
  stop("At least one S2.6 Mplus model did not terminate normally.")
}
```

# Extract model-fit information

```{r extract-model-fit}
summary_value <- function(summary_row, candidates, type = c("numeric", "character")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  available <- candidates[candidates %in% names(summary_row)]
  if (!length(available)) {
    return(if (type == "numeric") NA_real_ else NA_character_)
  }
  value <- summary_row[[available[1L]]][1L]
  if (type == "numeric") as.numeric(value) else as.character(value)
}

mplus_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))

parse_output_integer <- function(path, pattern) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  hit <- grep(pattern, lines, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  if (!length(hit)) return(NA_integer_)
  digits <- sub(".*?([0-9]+)\\s*$", "\\1", hit[1L], perl = TRUE)
  suppressWarnings(as.integer(digits))
}

extract_model_fit <- function(run) {
  summary_row <- run$parsed$summaries[1, , drop = FALSE]
  specification <- run$specification
  data.frame(
    row_type = "Model fit",
    model_order = run$model_order,
    model_id = run$model_id,
    model = run$model_label,
    within_structure = specification$within_structure,
    between_structure = specification$between_structure,
    between_p2_residual_variance = "Fixed to zero",
    mplus_version = summary_value(summary_row, "Mplus.version", "character"),
    estimator = summary_value(summary_row, "Estimator", "character"),
    analysis_type = summary_value(summary_row, "AnalysisType", "character"),
    observations = summary_value(summary_row, "Observations", "numeric"),
    clusters = parse_output_integer(run$paths$output, "Number of clusters"),
    free_parameters = summary_value(summary_row, "Parameters", "numeric"),
    scaled_chi_square = summary_value(summary_row, "ChiSqM_Value", "numeric"),
    df = summary_value(summary_row, "ChiSqM_DF", "numeric"),
    chi_square_p = summary_value(summary_row, "ChiSqM_PValue", "numeric"),
    robust_scaling_correction = summary_value(
      summary_row, "ChiSqM_ScalingCorrection", "numeric"
    ),
    cfi = summary_value(summary_row, "CFI", "numeric"),
    tli = summary_value(summary_row, "TLI", "numeric"),
    rmsea = summary_value(summary_row, "RMSEA_Estimate", "numeric"),
    srmr_within = summary_value(
      summary_row,
      c("SRMR.Within", "SRMR_Within", "SRMR_W", "SRMRWithin"),
      "numeric"
    ),
    srmr_between = summary_value(
      summary_row,
      c("SRMR.Between", "SRMR_Between", "SRMR_B", "SRMRBetween"),
      "numeric"
    ),
    loglikelihood = summary_value(summary_row, "LL", "numeric"),
    aic = summary_value(summary_row, "AIC", "numeric"),
    bic = summary_value(summary_row, "BIC", "numeric"),
    adjusted_bic = summary_value(summary_row, "aBIC", "numeric"),
    normal_termination = run$normal_termination,
    warnings = flatten_messages(run$parsed$warnings),
    errors = flatten_messages(run$parsed$errors),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

model_fit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_model_fit)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(model_order) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_cfi = c(NA_real_, diff(cfi)),
    delta_tli = c(NA_real_, diff(tli)),
    delta_rmsea = c(NA_real_, diff(rmsea)),
    delta_srmr_within = c(NA_real_, diff(srmr_within)),
    delta_srmr_between = c(NA_real_, diff(srmr_between)),
    delta_aic = c(NA_real_, diff(aic)),
    delta_bic = c(NA_real_, diff(bic)),
    delta_adjusted_bic = c(NA_real_, diff(adjusted_bic))
  )

if (!all(model_fit$mplus_version == "8.7")) {
  stop(
    "S2.6 is authorized for local Mplus 8.7, but the executable reported ",
    paste(unique(model_fit$mplus_version), collapse = ", "),
    ": ", mplus_command
  )
}

stopifnot(
  nrow(model_fit) == 3L,
  all(model_fit$normal_termination),
  all(model_fit$estimator == "MLR"),
  all(model_fit$observations == 17759L),
  all(model_fit$clusters == 209L),
  all(is.finite(model_fit$scaled_chi_square)),
  all(is.finite(model_fit$robust_scaling_correction)),
  all(model_fit$robust_scaling_correction > 0)
)

knitr::kable(
  model_fit |>
    dplyr::select(
      model, scaled_chi_square, df, chi_square_p,
      robust_scaling_correction, cfi, tli, rmsea,
      srmr_within, srmr_between, aic, bic, adjusted_bic
    ),
  digits = 4
)
```

# Sequential Satorra--Bentler scaled likelihood-ratio tests

For the more restrictive model 0 and less restrictive model 1, the official
MLR calculation is

\[
c_d = \frac{d_0c_0-d_1c_1}{d_0-d_1}, \qquad
T_{Rd} = \frac{T_0c_0-T_1c_1}{c_d}.
\]

Here, \(T\), \(d\), and \(c\) are the Mplus-reported scaled chi-square,
degrees of freedom, and scaling correction factor, respectively.

```{r sequential-scaled-tests}
get_fit_row <- function(fit_table, model_id) {
  row <- fit_table[fit_table$model_id == model_id, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) != 1L) stop("Could not find a unique fit row for ", model_id)
  row
}

scaled_mlr_difference <- function(
  fit_table,
  order,
  comparison,
  h0_id,
  h1_id,
  tested_split
) {
  h0 <- get_fit_row(fit_table, h0_id)
  h1 <- get_fit_row(fit_table, h1_id)
  difference_df <- h0$df - h1$df
  if (!is.finite(difference_df) || difference_df <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid nested-model degrees-of-freedom difference for ", comparison)
  }
  difference_scaling_correction <- (
    h0$df * h0$robust_scaling_correction -
      h1$df * h1$robust_scaling_correction
  ) / difference_df
  scaled_difference_chi_square <- (
    h0$scaled_chi_square * h0$robust_scaling_correction -
      h1$scaled_chi_square * h1$robust_scaling_correction
  ) / difference_scaling_correction
  difference_p <- stats::pchisq(
    scaled_difference_chi_square,
    df = difference_df,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  data.frame(
    row_type = "Sequential scaled MLR test",
    comparison_order = order,
    comparison = comparison,
    tested_split = tested_split,
    more_restrictive_h0 = h0_id,
    less_restrictive_h1 = h1_id,
    h0_scaled_chi_square = h0$scaled_chi_square,
    h0_df = h0$df,
    h0_scaling_correction = h0$robust_scaling_correction,
    h1_scaled_chi_square = h1$scaled_chi_square,
    h1_df = h1$df,
    h1_scaling_correction = h1$robust_scaling_correction,
    difference_scaling_correction = difference_scaling_correction,
    scaled_difference_chi_square = scaled_difference_chi_square,
    difference_df = difference_df,
    difference_p = difference_p,
    conclusion = ifelse(
      difference_p < .05,
      paste0(h1_id, " fits significantly better than ", h0_id),
      paste0(h1_id, " does not fit significantly better than ", h0_id)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

sequential_tests <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  scaled_mlr_difference(
    fit_table = model_fit,
    order = 1L,
    comparison = "Model 2 vs Model 1",
    h0_id = "M1_1W1B",
    h1_id = "M2_1W2B",
    tested_split = "Between-person General factor versus Peripheral + Core"
  ),
  scaled_mlr_difference(
    fit_table = model_fit,
    order = 2L,
    comparison = "Model 3 vs Model 2",
    h0_id = "M2_1W2B",
    h1_id = "M3_2W2B",
    tested_split = "Within-person General factor versus Peripheral + Core"
  )
)

stopifnot(
  identical(
    sequential_tests$comparison,
    c("Model 2 vs Model 1", "Model 3 vs Model 2")
  ),
  all(sequential_tests$difference_df > 0),
  all(sequential_tests$difference_scaling_correction > 0),
  all(sequential_tests$scaled_difference_chi_square >= 0),
  all(sequential_tests$difference_p >= 0 & sequential_tests$difference_p <= 1)
)

knitr::kable(sequential_tests, digits = 4)
```

# Extract complete STDYX results

```{r extract-stdyx, results='asis'}
factor_labels <- c(
  FW = "Within General PSMU",
  PW = "Within Peripheral",
  CW = "Within Core",
  FB = "Between General PSMU",
  PB = "Between Peripheral",
  CB = "Between Core"
)
item_labels <- setNames(ema_items, toupper(mplus_item_names))

label_parameter <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  factor_hit <- x %in% names(factor_labels)
  item_hit <- x %in% names(item_labels)
  x[factor_hit] <- unname(factor_labels[x[factor_hit]])
  x[item_hit] <- unname(item_labels[x[item_hit]])
  x
}

extract_stdyx <- function(run) {
  standard <- run$parsed$parameters$stdyx.standardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c("est", "se", "est_se", "pval")),
      mplus_numeric
    ))
  standard_ci <- run$parsed$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c("low2.5", "up2.5")),
      mplus_numeric
    )) |>
    dplyr::select(
      paramHeader,
      param,
      BetweenWithin,
      ci_lower = low2.5,
      ci_upper = up2.5
    )

  standard |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      standard_ci,
      by = c("paramHeader", "param", "BetweenWithin")
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      parameter_group = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("\\.BY$", paramHeader) ~ "Factor loading",
        grepl("\\.WITH$", paramHeader) ~ "Factor covariance/correlation",
        paramHeader == "Variances" ~ "Latent variance",
        paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" ~ "Residual variance",
        paramHeader == "Intercepts" ~ "Indicator intercept",
        TRUE ~ paramHeader
      ),
      lhs_code = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("\\.(BY|WITH)$", paramHeader) ~ sub("\\.(BY|WITH)$", "", paramHeader),
        TRUE ~ param
      ),
      operator = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("\\.BY$", paramHeader) ~ "BY",
        grepl("\\.WITH$", paramHeader) ~ "WITH",
        paramHeader == "Variances" ~ "VAR",
        paramHeader == "Residual.Variances" ~ "RESIDUAL_VAR",
        paramHeader == "Intercepts" ~ "INTERCEPT",
        TRUE ~ paramHeader
      ),
      rhs_code = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("\\.(BY|WITH)$", paramHeader) ~ param,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      lhs = label_parameter(lhs_code),
      rhs = label_parameter(rhs_code),
      fixed_or_not_tested = is.na(pval) | pval >= 900 | se == 0,
      se_clean = ifelse(fixed_or_not_tested, NA_real_, se),
      z_clean = ifelse(fixed_or_not_tested, NA_real_, est_se),
      p_clean = ifelse(fixed_or_not_tested, NA_real_, pval),
      ci_lower_clean = ifelse(abs(ci_lower) >= 998, NA_real_, ci_lower),
      ci_upper_clean = ifelse(abs(ci_upper) >= 998, NA_real_, ci_upper)
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      model_order = run$model_order,
      model_id = run$model_id,
      model = run$model_label,
      level = BetweenWithin,
      parameter_group,
      lhs,
      operator,
      rhs,
      mplus_parameter_header = paramHeader,
      mplus_parameter = param,
      stdyx_estimate = est,
      stdyx_se = se_clean,
      stdyx_z = z_clean,
      stdyx_p = p_clean,
      ci_95_lower = ci_lower_clean,
      ci_95_upper = ci_upper_clean,
      fixed_or_not_tested
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
      factor(level, levels = c("Within", "Between")),
      factor(parameter_group, levels = c(
        "Factor loading",
        "Factor covariance/correlation",
        "Latent variance",
        "Indicator intercept",
        "Residual variance"
      )),
      lhs,
      rhs
    )
}
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
extract_diagnostics <- function(run) {
  standard <- run$parsed$parameters$stdyx.standardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(est = mplus_numeric(est))
  residual_rows <- standard[
    standard$paramHeader == "Residual.Variances",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  unstandard <- run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(est = mplus_numeric(est))
  residual_unstandardized <- unstandard[
    unstandard$paramHeader == "Residual.Variances",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  warnings_text <- flatten_messages(run$parsed$warnings)
  errors_text <- flatten_messages(run$parsed$errors)

  data.frame(
    model_order = run$model_order,
    model_id = run$model_id,
    normal_termination = run$normal_termination,
    errors_n = length(run$parsed$errors),
    warnings_n = length(run$parsed$warnings),
    errors = errors_text,
    warnings = warnings_text,
    minimum_stdyx_residual_variance = if (nrow(residual_rows)) {
      min(residual_rows$est, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else NA_real_,
    minimum_unstandardized_residual_variance = if (nrow(residual_unstandardized)) {
      min(residual_unstandardized$est, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else NA_real_,
    negative_variance_flag = if (nrow(residual_unstandardized)) {
      any(residual_unstandardized$est < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else FALSE,
    theta_warning = !is.na(warnings_text) && grepl(
      "THETA.*NOT POSITIVE DEFINITE",
      warnings_text,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_diagnostics)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(model_order)
stopifnot(
  all(diagnostics$normal_termination),
  all(diagnostics$errors_n == 0L),
  !any(diagnostics$negative_variance_flag),
  !any(diagnostics$theta_warning),
  all(diagnostics$minimum_unstandardized_residual_variance == 0)
)
```

# Export the four-sheet result workbook

The workbook is created by `bruceR::export()` and formatted reproducibly in R.
`Fit_and_Comparisons` presents the complete fit information in a compact long
format, followed by both sequential tests. The other sheets retain the complete
STDYX output for the three models reported in the manuscript.

```{r export-workbook}
round_numeric_columns <- function(data, digits = 4L) {
  p_columns <- intersect(c("p_value", "stdyx_p"), names(data))
  numeric_non_p <- setdiff(
    names(data)[vapply(data, is.numeric, logical(1))],
    p_columns
  )
  data |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(numeric_non_p), ~ round(.x, digits))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.factor), as.character))
}

}))

  openxlsx::pageSetup(
    workbook,
    sheet = sheet_name,
    orientation = "landscape",
    fitToWidth = 1,
    fitToHeight = 0
  )

repair_orphan_drawing_relationships <- function(xlsx_file) {
  repair_dir <- tempfile("baseline_cfa_xlsx_repair_")
  dir.create(repair_dir)
  on.exit(unlink(repair_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  members <- utils::unzip(xlsx_file, list = TRUE)$Name
  # Reject unsafe archive paths before extracting a package.
  unsafe_member <- function(path) {
    parts <- strsplit(gsub("\\\\", "/", path), "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    grepl("^[/\\\\]|^[A-Za-z]:", path) || any(parts == "..")
  }
  stopifnot(length(members) > 0L, !anyDuplicated(members),
            !any(vapply(members, unsafe_member, logical(1))))
  utils::unzip(xlsx_file, exdir = repair_dir)
  relationship_files <- list.files(
    file.path(repair_dir, "xl", "worksheets", "_rels"),
    pattern = "\\.rels$", full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (!length(relationship_files)) return(invisible(0L))

  resolve_member <- function(target) {
    target <- gsub("\\\\", "/", utils::URLdecode(target))
    if (!nzchar(target) || grepl("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:", target)) {
      stop("Invalid internal drawing target")
    }
    parts <- strsplit(target, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    result <- if (startsWith(target, "/")) character() else c("xl", "worksheets")
    for (part in parts) {
      if (!nzchar(part) || part == ".") next
      if (part == "..") {
        if (!length(result)) stop("Drawing target escapes the workbook package")
        result <- head(result, -1L)
      } else result <- c(result, part)
    }
    paste(result, collapse = "/")
  }
  drawing_types <- paste0(
    "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/",
    c("drawing", "vmlDrawing")
  )
  removed_relationships <- 0L
  for (relationship_file in relationship_files) {
    document <- xml2::read_xml(relationship_file, options = "NONET")
    relationships <- xml2::xml_find_all(
      document, "/*[local-name()='Relationships']/*[local-name()='Relationship']"
    )
    changed <- FALSE
    for (relationship in relationships) {
      type <- xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "Type")
      external <- identical(xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "TargetMode"), "External")
      if (!type %in% drawing_types || external) next
      target <- xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "Target")
      if (is.na(target)) stop("Drawing relationship is missing its Target")
      if (!resolve_member(target) %in% members) {
        xml2::xml_remove(relationship)
        removed_relationships <- removed_relationships + 1L
        changed <- TRUE
      }
    }
    if (changed) xml2::write_xml(document, relationship_file)
  }
  if (removed_relationships == 0L) return(invisible(0L))

  repaired_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
  on.exit(unlink(repaired_file), add = TRUE)
  archive_members <- list.files(
    repair_dir, recursive = TRUE, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE
  )
  zip::zipr(
    zipfile = repaired_file, files = archive_members, root = repair_dir,
    include_directories = FALSE, mode = "mirror"
  )
  stopifnot(file.exists(repaired_file), file.info(repaired_file)$size > 0)
  stopifnot(file.copy(repaired_file, xlsx_file, overwrite = TRUE))
  invisible(removed_relationships)
}

orphan_relationships_removed <- repair_orphan_drawing_relationships(table_file)
stopifnot(
  file.exists(table_file),
  file.info(table_file)$size > 0,
  identical(openxlsx::getSheetNames(table_file), names(workbook_sheets))
)
```

```{r save-result-bundle}
project_root_normalized <- normalizePath(project_root, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
make_relative_path <- function(path) {
  normalized <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  prefix <- paste0(project_root_normalized, "/")
  if (startsWith(normalized, prefix)) {
    substring(normalized, nchar(prefix) + 1L)
  } else normalized
}
```

```{r validation-checks, include=FALSE}
    all(model_fit$normal_termination) &&
      all(model_fit$estimator == "MLR") &&
      all(model_fit$analysis_type == "TWOLEVEL") &&
      all(model_fit$observations == 17759L) &&
      all(model_fit$clusters == 209L),
    !any(diagnostics$negative_variance_flag) &&
      !any(diagnostics$theta_warning),
    identical(
      sequential_tests$comparison,
      c("Model 2 vs Model 1", "Model 3 vs Model 2")
    ),
    identical(vapply(stdyx_results, nrow, integer(1)), c(
      M1_1W1B = 32L,
      M2_1W2B = 34L,
      M3_2W2B = 36L
    )),
    identical(readxl::excel_sheets(table_file), names(workbook_sheets)) &&
      all(workbook_audit$formula_error_cells == 0L),
    identical(
      verified_objects,
      "fit_s2_10_multilevel_cfa_new_model_order_p2var0"
    ),
    nrow(mplus_file_manifest) == 9L &&
      all(file.exists(file.path(project_root, mplus_file_manifest$relative_path))) &&
      identical(
        unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(project_root, mplus_file_manifest$relative_path))),
        mplus_file_manifest$md5
      )
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (!all(validation_checks$passed)) {
  stop(
    "S2.6 validation failed: ",
    paste(validation_checks$check[!validation_checks$passed], collapse = "; ")
  )
}
```
